hooks.command: PROJECT_ROOT="$(git -C "$(dirname "$0")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; CHANGED=$(git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(ts|js|json|html|scss|css)$' | grep -v 'node_modules' | grep -v 'README.md' | grep -v '\.claude/' | head -5); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo "[README REMINDER] Source files were modified in this session. Consider updating README.md if the changes affect: project structure, setup steps, API routes, test coverage, or architecture."; echo "Changed files: $CHANGED"; fi
